issues.message: High First Contentful Paint (FCP) on Homepage
issues.recommendation: Consider optimizing the initial content rendering on the homepage to improve user experience.

insights: The Time To First Byte (TTFB) is consistently low across all pages, indicating that the server response times are good.
The load times for the pricing and blog pages are very fast, which is a positive sign for user experience.

The how it works page failed the test, suggesting that there might be some issues with this page that need to be addressed. It could be due to a larger size, more complex scripts, or other factors that are causing it to take longer to load.
